- [FACT] User is a teacher.
- [PREFERENCE] User believes that building relationships with students with disabilities is important for providing support.
- [PREFERENCE] User thinks technology can be a great supplement to teaching, especially with the variety of assistive technology available today.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Flexible furniture in classroom design can help provide students with disabilities better accessibility and mobility options.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistive technology should be integrated into classroom design to support students with disabilities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Clear signage and visuals in classrooms aid non-verbal communication for students with intellectual impairments or communication disorders.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Accessible flooring and pathways should be installed to allow children with mobility impairments to navigate around the classroom.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Good quality, glare-free lighting should be provided in classrooms, with a control system for students to adjust lighting levels.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] An inclusive classroom should have adequate space for students to maneuver and ample storage for specialized equipment.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Designing sensory-friendly spaces within classrooms can benefit students with disabilities, such as quiet corners and noise-cancelling headphones.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Examples of assistive technology include text-to-speech software, alternative input devices, magnification software, captioning and subtitling software, virtual reality, and communication software.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Technology provides tools that support learning and participation but does not replace the need for human connection, empathy, and understanding.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Teachers play an important role in providing emotional and social support to students with disabilities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Strategies to balance technology use and promote independence include using technology as a tool, developing alternative strategies, encouraging self-advocacy, allowing exploration, regular evaluation of technology tools, and creating a collaborative environment.
